strategy.offer: Integrated identity and mobile security solutions for authentication, transaction authorization, app and browser protection, secure communication, and supporting infrastructure or managed services.
strategy.customers: Organizations digitizing customer or employee processes across web and mobile channels, especially those needing strong, compliant security for sensitive interactions.
strategy.why_we_win: They claim secure, usable cross-platform identity processing integrates with existing systems, adds trusted second-channel communication, and meets demanding regulatory and risk requirements.
strategy.resources: Deep authentication and cryptography know-how, a substantial R&D share, security servers, SDKs, hardware options, and experience developing encryption-related technology.
strategy.direction: Toward broader secure digital ecosystems: binding mobile communication, app-based interactions, online contract signing, and one secure identity across channels and services.
